regional convenience store.notes: Sells items with better value (higher uses for same price). Triggers region-specific CYOA after purchase.

restaurant.notes: Fills everyone's food meter, random cost based on price tier, CYOA after service.

car store.notes: Heal car ($30) and upgrade shocks ($50, increases encumbrance capacity by 1).

phone store.notes: Can purchase additional phones ($100) and upgrade phone batteries for each phone.

hike/walk.notes: Triggers CYOA event 'walk' that restores all of Mitch's fun.
